notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.1.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546837/d5ff1692b1ad1afabe51c45efd47b40b35f3620f.png[/img]
In this patch, we introduce a new ability, Pick Up, and a Team feature for Co-Op PVP.

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1]
[b]• Pick Up[/b]
- You pick up ANY golf ball and carry it freely with a slightly reduced speed.
- You cannot jump or drop your golf ball over the other side of the wall.

(Note: This ability allows you to navigate steadily through tricky areas, unstuck a golf ball near the water, or straight up steal someone’s golf ball)

[b]• Team[/b]
- You can now pick a team in the lobby.
- The team will share the same color (Orange / Purple) and the total score.
- No, you cannot hit your teammate.

(Note: You can also play in an asymmetrical team!)

[b]• Stage[/b]
- Adjust the layout for certain stages.
- 0.1.4 Stage rotation includes [Cove 3, 4, 5] and [Cemetery 2, 3, 4]

[h1][b]UX/UI[/b][/h1]
[b]• Intro Camera[/b]
- The camera will show the stage overview before the game starts.

[b]Lobby[/b]
- Now has a team changing zone
- Slightly improve the tutorial and buttons.

[b]Main Menu[/b]
- Cove & Cemetery variants are now animated!

[b]Preparation[/b]
- Improve the visual of the scene

[b]Button Glyph[/b]
- Update the glyph visual for PlayStation and Xbox controller buttons.

[h1][b]OTHER[/b][/h1]
- Add new cosmetics (Some are still just a mock-up) 
- Add a hidden upcoming feature. Let’s see if you can find it!

[h1][b]BUG FIX[/b][/h1]
- A LOT! * Sweating Profusely *

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546837/43ad776c99a34089eb5d7a5daba2abadac1c8066.png[/img]
In this patch, we want to tackle the problem of things that are too hard to control or interact with.

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1]

[b]• Golf Swing [/b]
- Tap & Full Swing hit-box collisions have been adjusted to cover more areas. (Should overall feel easier to connect each shot)

[b]• Golf Ball [/b]
- Is now lighter and bouncier against the wall. You can now use Full Swing to cross the water in certain stages

[b]• Stage [/b]
- Adjust most stages to have fewer walls & obstacles along the pain path, and lower the difficulty of certain stages.
- The stages in the demo will now cycle from time to time to keep things fresh.
- 0.1.3 Stage rotation includes [Cove 6, 7, 8] and [Cemetery 7, 8, 9]

[b]• Checkpoint [/b]
- Now respawn BOTH players or golf balls near the checkpoint whenever they fall off the stage.
- Removed the checkpoint secure period. The player can now capture the checkpoint at any moment.

[b]• Explosive Barrel [/b]
- Now has 7 HP
- Now knocks further when the player swings at it

[b]• Ghosts [/b]
- [Wander Ghost] Reduce wandering radius significantly.
- [Ghost Statue] Will now release the ghost wave when the player walks in front of it. (Note: You can still hit it from another angle to release the ghosts) The cooldown has been increased slightly.

[h1][b]UX/UI[/b][/h1]

• Added Main Menu & Preparation Scene

[b]• Indicator [/b]
- [Golf Alert] When you wander off too far from your own golf ball for a certain period, an indicator will appear to make it easier to find.
- Stage interactions now have an indicator that tells you how to interact with certain objects.
- Improve the critical strike indicator when fully charged.

[b]• Lobby [/b]
- Remote Play Zone now requires a confirmed button press to avoid players accidentally stepping on.
- Slightly improve the tutorial.

[b]• Button Glyph [/b]
- Now displays a matching button when connecting through PS4 and Xbox controllers.

[h1][b]SOUND[/b][/h1]
• New BGM for Cemetery theme.
• Added a randomized pitch and slightly reduced the overall volume of Tap & Full Swing sounds.

[h1][b]BUG FIX[/b][/h1]
• Fixed inaccurate colliders in various stages.
• Fixed the problem where you can get stuck inside an invisible wall in the lobby.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546837/0a1364f094c0b40fbdffe9fc81043dccd7863f44.png[/img]
In this patch, we want to improve the game feel for certain interactions, and make it more versatile.

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1]

[b]• Explosive Barrel (Rework) [/b]
- No longer has a random amount of HP before detonation.
- Now only explode when a player swings it against another  player/golf ball. (Also detonates faster!)
- Can now respawn after cooldown has ended.

[b]• Witch Pot[/b]
- Bottle of Speed Potion? Nah, Just Dive In 
Witch Pot now grants a temporary speed boost after exiting the pot.

[b]• Ghosts[/b]
- Can now smack at ghosts to knock them away.
Launch these ghosts at your opponent or pile them up to zone the area!

[b]• Crown System:[/b]
- The crown will now show up above the player with 1st place for 10 seconds after the game start countdown has ended. (If the first place is tied, the crown won’t be shown)

* This has no direct effect on the gameplay. Just want to let you know who’s in the lead. Hopefully everyone will approach them in a peaceful manner.

[h1][b]VISUAL[/b][/h1]

• Cemetery Ghost Statue now has a ghost inside it.
• Added an arrow that appears when the player is near the Witch Pot.

[h1][b]SOUND[/b][/h1]

• Updated a new sound for Tap Swing & Critical Strike.

[h1][b]BUG FIX[/b][/h1]

• Fixed the issue where Critical Strike impact triggers before the club reaches the player/golf ball.
• Fixed the issue where removing player using joystick shows the rejoin button as keyboard.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44546837/a00c078cd911b6a88df88ea1f7e7fc8672bf200f.png[/img]
In this patch, we want to simplify everything to be as easy to understand as possible.

[b][h2]IMPROVED UX/UI[/h2][/b]
• Added a “Remote Play Zone” to simplify the inviting process.
• Added a “Unassign Player Zone” to remove excess players.
• Added an exit game button. (We’re sorry!)

[b][h2]IMPROVED THE VISUAL CLARITY[/h2][/b]
• Added a highlighted outline when the player is near the intractable objects. 
• Adjusted the visual of Lobby & Cemetery Hole

[b][h2]BUG FIX[/h2][/b]
• Fixed an issue that caused the tentacle's hitbox to be larger than its actual size.
